req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the task update endpoint should ignore any changes to the task ID in the request body and only update the task specified by the URL. This ensures data integrity by preventing accidental or malicious changes to task identifiers. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior when no ID change is attempted, a negative test to ensure the system rejects or ignores ID changes, and a boundary test to check behavior at the edge of valid input ranges.

tests.name: test_update_task_ignore_id_change
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with a valid task update payload that includes an ID field with a different value.
expected: The task with ID 1 is updated with the new data, except for the ID field.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Initial Task", "description": "Initial Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()

# Action: Attempt to update the task with a different ID in the payload
update_response = client.put(f"/tasks/{created_task['id']}", json={"id": created_task['id'] + 1, "title": "Updated Task", "description": "Updated Description", "completed": True})

# Expected: The task is updated except for the ID
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()
assert updated_task['id'] == created_task['id']
assert updated_task['title'] == "Updated Task"
assert updated_task['description'] == "Updated Description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is True

tests.name: test_update_task_with_invalid_id
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/999 with a valid task update payload.
expected: The response status code is 404 indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Ensure no task with ID 999 exists

# Action: Attempt to update a non-existent task
update_response = client.put("/tasks/999", json={"title": "Non-existent Task", "description": "This task does not exist", "completed": False})

# Expected: The task is not found
assert update_response.status_code == 404
assert "Task with id 999 not found" in update_response.json()['detail']

tests.name: test_update_task_boundary_id
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with a valid task update payload and check behavior at the boundary of valid ID values.
expected: The task with ID 1 is updated correctly.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Update the task with boundary ID value

# Expected: The task is updated correctly

updated_task = update_response.json()
assert updated_task['id'] == created_task['id']
assert updated_task['title'] == "Boundary Updated Task"
